name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno, Nevada-based royalty and streaming company focused on gold and silver properties across established Nevada mining districts. The company operates a three-part business model: mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious-metals exploration streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. Key assets include the Olinghouse 1% royalty and a $5M earn-in to the Lapon Canyon gold project.
